fact: A Banco de Cabo Verde aviso, dated 21 January 2025 at the Governor's office, lets category A microfinance institutions provide payment services and issue electronic money, subject to prior authorisation by the Banco de Cabo Verde.
title: Boletim Oficial n.º 55, II Série de 25-03-2025
publisher: Boletim Oficial da República de Cabo Verde (Banco de Cabo Verde aviso)
